s: The most popular and beloved festival during the administration of Reddi kings?
x:
Vasantotsavam (Spring Festival) was the most popular festival during the rule of the Reddi Kings. The festival was celebrated with music, dance, literary gatherings, flower decorations and cultural performances. The Reddi rulers, who were great patrons of literature and fine arts, encouraged public celebrations and court festivals. Literary works of the period, particularly those of Srinatha, describe the grandeur of Vasantotsavam and its importance in the social and cultural life of the kingdom.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (3).
